test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly describes the use of a screw pitch gauge?

options.text: It determines the pitch of a thread on screws or bolts.
It measures the external diameter of cylindrical objects.
It verifies the length of threads on fasteners.
It measures the depth of internal threads in nuts.

solution:
The correct answer is __It determines the pitch of a thread on screws or bolts**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Screw pitch gauge__ is a measuring tool used for threads.
 
• It is used to measure the pitch or lead of a screw thread.
 
• Threads are identified by comparing them against the profiles on the gauge.
 
• The tool helps in matching thread profiles accurately.
 
• It is commonly used in mechanical engineering and manufacturing applications.
 
• The pitch is the distance between adjacent thread crests in millimeters (for metric threads).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Caliper:**

 
 
• A caliper is a tool used to measure the dimensions of an object.
 
• It can measure internal and external dimensions as well as depth.
 
 
 
• **Thread Ring Gauge:**
 
 
• Used for checking the external threads on a workpiece.
 
• Ensures the thread conforms to standard specifications.
 
 
 
• **Depth Gauge:**
 
 
• A device used to measure the depth of holes, slots, or recesses.
 
• Ensures precise depth measurements in engineering tasks.
